claims.description: Transform-list and individual translation functions project client geometry and hit boxes.

notes.text: Translation, percentages, transform-list order, unchanged flow and offset geometry, descendant propagation, and transformed point queries have exact Chromium parity coverage.
Taffy computes untransformed layout; the adapter projects border rectangles and hit boxes through ancestor and local affine transforms after layout.

claims.description: Transform-list and individual scale functions project client geometry and hit boxes.

notes.text: Scaling, percentages, browser-defined individual-property composition, transform-list order, descendant propagation, and transformed point queries have exact Chromium parity coverage.
Perspective and non-zero 3D transform functions remain unsupported and route through the configured unsupported CSS policy.

claims.description: Rotation, skew, and matrix functions project client geometry and polygonal hit regions.

notes.text: Bounding rectangles and point queries use the transformed quadrilateral, so empty corners of a rotated bounding rectangle do not become false hit targets.
`translateZ(0)` is accepted as a two-dimensional identity transform because the engine does not model compositing layers.

claims.description: Supported transform origins change the projection center without affecting layout flow.

notes.text: Default and explicit origins, including percentages, have exact Chromium parity coverage.

claims.description: Some transform interactions with clipping, stacking, and containing blocks remain unsupported.

notes.text: Overflow clipping is computed before transforms, and transform-created stacking contexts and containing blocks are not modeled. These can differ from Chromium when a transformed descendant crosses an overflow clip, participates in stacking-context ordering, or uses absolute/fixed positioning relative to a transformed ancestor.
